projects.title: TAQA Platform
projects.description: A modern B2B supplier management platform — designed and developed the complete frontend architecture and user interface with multilingual support (English, Arabic, Chinese) and rich interactive experiences.
highlights: Designed and developed the complete frontend architecture for a modern B2B supplier management platform using React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, and Radix UI
Built responsive and performance-optimized Single Page Application (SPA) interfaces with React 19 and Vite 6, ensuring fast rendering and reusable component architecture
Developed Admin and User dashboards with structured navigation, analytics views, supplier management modules, authentication workflows, and payment-related interfaces
Implemented multilingual localization support using i18next with English, Arabic, and Chinese translations across the entire platform
Enhanced user experience with smooth animations and modal transitions using Motion (Framer Motion) while maintaining scalable modular feature-based project structure
Integrated frontend services with backend APIs using Axios and TanStack React Query for efficient server-state management, caching, and error handling

projects.title: WorkRaze — Job Aggregation Platform
projects.description: A complete frontend for a job aggregation platform enabling users to efficiently browse opportunities by role, company, and location — with smooth animations and secure authentication flows.
highlights: Designed and developed the complete frontend architecture using React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui ensuring a scalable, reusable, and component-driven structure
Built responsive and user-friendly interfaces for job listings, advanced search, and filtering systems by role, company, and location
Integrated frontend with backend REST APIs handling asynchronous data fetching, loading states, caching, and error management for seamless user experience
Managed global application state using Context API for user authentication, session persistence, and application-wide data handling with protected routes
Implemented smooth animations, interactive UI transitions, and responsive layouts using Framer Motion and modern frontend optimization techniques
